repos_data.description: NXDrawKit is a simple and easy but useful drawing kit for iPhone
An iOS framework for easily adding drawings and text to images.

MS Paint for the Mac. Native, free and open source: blank canvas at any size, drop one image onto another, crop, and mark up screenshots. Ships PaintKit, a UI-free drawing engine with no AppKit and no third-party dependencies: macOS 12+, and swift test runs it in a fresh clone with no Xcode.
Proof of concept for a vector drawing app without canvas boundaries.
Powerful and easy-to-use vector graphics Swift library with SVG support
SVG parser and renderer written in SwiftUI

repo_meta_data.description: An open source library that lets your users draw on things - mark up images with text, shapes, etc.
